sources.source_description: Normal brain.6.Sagittal MRI scan; T1 weighted, side view, midline, normal anatomy
sources.calibration: Original5cm ruler retained. Nominal digitized pixels are not MR voxel resolution.
sources.orientation: Anterior image-left,posterior image-right,superior up from actual head anatomy; source midsagittal. No R/L marker inferred.
sources.geometry_limit: Cranial compartment and transition to upper cervical neural canal only; no whole spine, meningeal segmentation or traced CSF boundary.

sources.creator_credit: Vetrugno et al.(2020),The Ultrasound Journal12:39,Additionalfile1 ClipS1
sources.specimen: Clinical human thorax,anterior parasagittal; normal-aeration pattern in COVIDreview, not established healthy donor
sources.motion_limit: Includes source-labelled sliding,plus transducer rocking/tilting. No exact source acquisitionrate confirmed; encoded fps is delivery cadence.
sources.anatomical_limit: Pleural acoustic interface/A-lines, not resolved separate parietal/fluid/visceral layers; deeper A-lines are reverberation artifacts.
sources.rights: OwningCCBY4 includes images absent exclusion; nonefoundClipS1. Publication institutionalunidentifiableimagingpolicy stated. No invented consent/donor details.
sources.modifications: Complete source bytes unchanged; video extension M4V to MP4 only.

teaching_purpose: Cranial-to-upper-cervical context and an independent clinical pleural acoustic-interface observation.

poster.operation: Full-frame decoded PNG, no resize/color adjustment/new annotation.

video_operation: Unchanged publisher M4V bytes delivered with MP4 extension; no transcode, crop or timing change.
surfaces: Native video fallback and shared authored playback controls
coverage_gaps: Only upper cervical canal in MRI, not whole vertebral axis
No measured meningeal or CSF segmentation
No registration between MRI and ultrasound
